scope_note: Derived ONLY from ai-agent-tool repos ['agent-rally-point', 'build-loop', 'symphony', 'voltagent']. Categories are app-type-relative — this checklist does NOT transfer to other app types.

required.aliases: task state telemetry / cost usage telemetry / decision telemetry
required.day1_tell: Run one task end-to-end and verify logs/metrics include state transitions, cost usage, and the decision reason for each branch taken.

required.aliases: configuration preservation / strict setup enforcement / deployment policy enforcement
required.day1_tell: Deploy with a missing required config value and confirm setup/deployment fails before startup with a clear policy error.

required.aliases: global state preservation / state persistence / feedback state persistence
required.day1_tell: Restart the service after updating global/feedback state and confirm the state is restored exactly from persistence.

required.aliases: input validation / execution validation / message validation
required.day1_tell: Submit an invalid message containing a wrong type and unsafe payload and confirm validation rejects it before execution.
Run the project scaffolder with each documented option and confirm the generated files reflect the selected options.

required.aliases: quality gate hooks / quality gate wiring
required.day1_tell: Introduce a failing lint/test quality gate and confirm the configured hook blocks the commit/build.
Update source data, invalidate the cache, and confirm synchronized consumers observe the new value exactly once.

required.aliases: remote event support / event type support
required.day1_tell: Publish each supported remote event type and confirm the receiver routes and handles each type correctly.
Run the diagnostic command after a forced error and confirm it prints relevant IDs, state, and log pointers.
Commit a workflow file with a known unsafe pattern and confirm workflow linting fails with a hard error.
Run the status command during queued, running, failed, and completed work and confirm each state is reported accurately.
Submit equivalent identifiers with different case/separators and confirm they canonicalize to one stable ID.
Build the artifact and confirm its license/provenance report lists every bundled dependency with license and source.
Write a checkpoint through one path and read it through all supported checkpoint readers, confirming identical content.
Inject a transient network failure and confirm the operation retries without losing the original request context.

optional.aliases: metadata preservation / message metadata persistence / failure metadata preservation
optional.day1_tell: Force a message-processing failure with custom metadata attached and confirm the persisted failure record retains the original metadata unchanged.

optional.aliases: coordination gating / coordination isolation / coordination facts
optional.day1_tell: Start two coordinators against the same work item and confirm only the gated coordinator proceeds while the other records the blocking coordination fact.

optional.aliases: schema compatibility support / schema compatibility handling / schema compatibility
optional.day1_tell: Load data written with the previous schema version and confirm the current code migrates or reads it without data loss.
Attempt to merge/apply changes from a stale base revision and confirm the system blocks it with a stale-base error.
Run the query migration tool on a legacy candidate query and confirm it produces the expected new query form with equivalent results.

optional.aliases: handoff validation relaxation / handoff payload validation
optional.day1_tell: Send a handoff payload with optional fields omitted and confirm relaxed validation accepts it while still rejecting malformed required fields.
Start two leaders with the same lease backend and confirm only the valid lease holder performs leadership actions.
Resolve relative, absolute, symlinked, and workspace-root paths and confirm each routes to the intended target safely.
Deploy a build that fails verification and confirm the deployment gate prevents promotion.
Load every agent definition and confirm required fields, tools, prompts, and permissions validate successfully.
Validate the default configuration against the published schema and confirm invalid extra or mistyped fields are rejected.
Import the package's schema factory from its public entrypoint and confirm it creates the expected schema object.
Stream a response with metadata on each chunk and confirm downstream consumers receive the forwarded metadata intact.

optional.aliases: stale data cleanup / orphan data cleanup
optional.day1_tell: Create orphaned/stale records, run cleanup, and confirm only unreachable stale data is deleted.

optional.aliases: stream lifecycle guarding / stream lock avoidance
optional.day1_tell: Open, close, cancel, and error a stream while holding locks and confirm lifecycle guards release locks in every path.
Replay the same persistence event twice and confirm only one durable record is created.
Upsert duplicate logical records in different orders and confirm the final stored record is stable and deduplicated.

optional.aliases: tool routing preservation / tool routing refactor
optional.day1_tell: Invoke each tool through the routing layer and confirm it reaches the same tool implementation as before the refactor.

optional.aliases: execution context primitives / execution context exposure
optional.day1_tell: Run a task and confirm execution context exposes request ID, workspace, user, cancellation, and deadline primitives.
Run two workspaces with similarly named files and confirm each operation reads/writes only within its own workspace.
